name: Akahoshi Manato
source:
A strange young man who invited Haruno to live with him by asking, "Why don't you become my cat?" However, contrary to his blunt words and actions, he's a kind "owner" who treats Haruno very carefully and spoils her.

Despite his playful appearance, he's actually very sensitive to people's subtleties and has a caring yet serious personality. He loves cats like no other.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/nekonare/nekonare.html]official website[/url]]
